components.name: PillNav
components.finding: Capsule navigation with split/joined logo, fill or gliding highlight, controlled activeHref or local selection. Native anchors/buttons, named nav and focus rings. ResizeObserver collapses to menu; Escape restores toggle focus; outside click closes. onMenuToggle does not report outside/Escape/resize closes; route wiring and logo asset required.
components.visual: Medium: raised pills, glass/solid/none surface, dark/light tokens
components.layout: Marketing navigation; responsive collapsed mobile navigation
components.motion: Native RAF spring indicator and press; CSS rolling labels/fill; Web Animations intro, logo spin and mobile panel. Event-driven; stops settled; no scroll dependency. Reduced motion skips intro/spin/panel and snaps springs; residual dot color transition and instantaneous press scale remain.

components.name: CircularGallery
components.finding: WebGL2 curved infinite image carousel with DOM labels and hidden roving buttons, drag/wheel/arrow navigation, click expansion and close. Parent height required; no visible fallback without WebGL2. Wheel prevents page scrolling. Keyboard opens even when openOnClick false and does not invoke onItemClick; Home/End do not transfer focus. Empty list loads demo photos. Remote images need CORS; default font fetches Google Fonts.

components.finding: OGL WebGL2 infinite photo row through refractive lens, expanding selected photo and captions/counter. Keyboard arrows/Home/End/Enter/Space/Escape and focus ring. Needs parent height; blank without WebGL2 and no visible fallback. Default captures vertical wheel; set captureWheel false for normal page scrolling. Caption rendered below row despite prose saying above. Empty input substitutes demo images; no explicit autoplay pause control.

components.name: Masonry
components.finding: Responsive shortest-column photo grid with spans, scroll reveals, hover captions, mouse reorder and body-portal lightbox. Native tile links/buttons and focus restoration. Lightbox declares aria-modal but lacks focus trap/background inert; resize does not directly recalculate open frame. Reorder lacks keyboard/touch equivalent and persistence. Explicit image dimensions avoid measurement delay; every image renders without lazy loading. Hover captions need always mode on touch.
components.visual: Medium to high: asymmetric photography grid, rounded images, gradient captions; choose no hover/reveal/parallax for restrained collections
components.layout: Masonry/asymmetric image grid; image library; gallery lightbox
components.motion: Native RAF spring reveal/reflow and drag; CSS hover zoom/lift/tilt; Web Animations removal and shared-image lightbox; optional scroll parallax. Event-driven. Reduced snaps initial layout/reveal and lightbox but CSS hover/caption/image fade, optional parallax and drag settlement remain.

motionDetails.mobile: Auto columns and small-screen lightbox padding; touch drag intentionally disabled; captions hover not reliable on touch
